analysis:
Scope: the optional root fan helper (TB-010; T-044..T-048, A-014). The PR adds periodic rediscovery when the startup inventory has no fans or GPU sensors. No coordinator, attestation, encryption or billing paths changed.

FanDaemon.swift (head):
- tick L205: returns early while shuttingDown or pendingRestorations>0. If inventory is empty (L211), it calls recoverStartupInventory (L250-298).
- recoverStartupInventory first calls restoreAutomatic using the old inventory. It aborts on a lifecycleRevision change; the revision is bumped by emergencyRestore L147, shutdown L172, prepareForSleep L181 and didWake L190. It sets mode .error if restoration fails.
- Rediscovery is rate limited to 30s (L267-271).
- It replaces inventory and controller only when no possible ownership exists (no controlling controller and no journal) and no restoration is pending (L278-282). The swap happens with no suspension point between the checks and the replacement.
- On replacement it clears providerLease, policy samples and readings (L285-294). A fresh lease is then required via renewLease L123, which is still gated by effectiveEnabled (now including !shuttingDown, L201) and powerSuspended.
- Discovery itself never engages fans; engagement still goes through policy.evaluate and apply.
- thermalState is now injectable (L28, L57, L227) with the same serious/critical safety override.
- restoreAutomatic counts pending restorations (L354-355).

No regression found in lease gating (T-044) or ownership journaling (T-046/T-047).

Residuals for the next pass:
- Rediscovery uses reader.discover(brandString: inventory.chipFamily.rawValue) at L273. The startup path likely uses the sysctl brand string instead. If chipFamily is unknown or the raw value maps differently, discovery may select a different or generic GPU sensor mapping (T-048 unsafe sensor mapping). The reader source was not supplied.
- If a restoration hangs, the tick guard at L205 suppresses all ticks, including lease-lapse restore retries. Restoration was already in progress in that case, so this is likely benign availability behavior.
- The test harness (f712a72149b38034) is metadata-only.
- The docs at fan-control.md L111-125 match the code.
